authority.source_authority: logos-scripture-graph owns canonical-66 pointers; logos-boundary-literature owns boundary pointers; Lowell Wong authorized both metadata-only writes on 2026-07-19.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-writer may mutate T518/T003 worktrees; independent-checker receives read-only paths and may not edit either repository.

roles.why_needed: One writer must keep cross-repository identity, schema, fingerprints, and content-lane routing coherent.
roles.mission: Create metadata-only canonical and boundary pointer registries with deterministic validation and no source ingestion.
roles.authority: May write only the T518 and T003 allowed paths in their isolated worktrees; cannot download sources, change canon scope, or modify governance.
acceptance_conditions: No boundary rows exist in Scripture Graph and no canonical rows exist in Boundary Literature.
stop_conditions: A source text or image would be copied.

roles.why_needed: The manifest skill requires an independent review of false authority, coverage claims, and cross-repository contamination.
roles.mission: Read both diffs and replay focused checks; report correctness, scope, false-authority risks, and release gate without editing.
roles.authority: Read-only review; cannot mutate files, approve governance adoption, or grant rights.
acceptance_conditions: Independent findings cite concrete files or validation output.

readiness_conditions: Both worktrees are readable and focused validators can be replayed.

proof_obligations.description: Prove canonical and boundary records are stored only in their owning repositories and mixed codices use companion pointers.
Prove the registry does not claim static item-level completeness and distinguishes roots from curated direct witnesses.
Prove every row denies download authority and keeps rights unreviewed.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Adoption of the shared pointer schema in logos-governance-architecture is deferred because its active checkout is conflicted and no governance mutation is required for candidate local registries.
